text:
Caroline: Quick heads up — marketplace e2e signals flagged a perf regression on CUDA 12.3.1 + driver 535.x for A100 workloads. Seen on canary images in eu-west. Tagging @Ethan @Sofia to loop in partner comms.
Ethan: Do we have a simple repro or perf numbers? can you paste logs?
Caroline: Minimal repro in sandbox. Gen 2k tokens seqs show ~1.8x slower than baseline. snippet:
```
# run in sandbox
python perf_test.py --model gpt-small --seq 2048 --batch 1
# result: 1200ms -> baseline 680ms
```
Sofia: Oof. Partner pushed a kernel tweak last week — could be ABI drift. Are we seeing any driver oops/kelogs?
Devon: From skimming logs it smells like driver/userland mismatch (535.x). My read: safe move is to pin marketplace images to 534.72 while we triage. Suggestion: create a hotfix AMI tag and short-lived manifest override.
Arjun: I can do the manifest rewrite and kick a canary. Can we also add a fallback runtime that uses quantized kernels to reduce perf impact if we can't fully revert quickly?
Caroline: Proposed plan:
  1) Pin marketplace AMIs to driver 534.72 (`r-inference-534-pin` tag)
  2) Create hotfix manifest override + canary in eu-west and ap-southeast
  3) Run smoke + perf threshold in canary (include 2k seq gen)
  4) Draft partner comms + postmortem stub
ETA for hotfix push: ~4h. objections?
Ethan: :thumbsup: No objections. Also please include rollback steps and test vectors in the runbook.
Sofia: I'll draft the partner-facing note and loop in SI leads. Also recommend we add an automated preflight perf check to the marketplace pipeline — small harness that runs gen + asserts latency < X.
marketplace-bot: Deploy pipeline: hotfix-manifest-build triggered (build id: bf-2026-03-22-09-12)
Caroline: @Devon can you attach kernel changelog to the hotfix doc? I'll open the comms draft once canary is green.
Devon: Will attach changelog and open incident ticket for visibility. Also adding a short checklist for guests: how to opt back to 535 once upstream fixes land.
Arjun: Rollback/manifests quick command if needed:
```
sed -E 's/driverVersion: .*/driverVersion: "534.72"/' marketplace/manifest.yaml > marketplace/manifest.fix.yaml
# then push manifest.fix.yaml to canary lane
```
Arjun: I'll run canary in ap-southeast-1 first and share telemetry.
Caroline: Thanks all. I'll hold on partner comms until canary perf numbers are in. :white_check_mark:
